entities.summary: Prégent de Bidoux, also known as Peri Joan or Perrianni, was a French admiral born of unknown origins and died in 1528. He played a significant role in the Mediterranean Sea's naval power dynamics during the Italian Wars. Bidoux Pregent's leadership and strategic decisions influenced the course of naval warfare and shaped the European maritime landscape. His legacy can be seen in the development of modern naval tactics and the expansion of French maritime influence. The French naval tradition that Bidoux Pregent helped establish continues to be studied by naval historians today. The strategic importance of the Mediterranean during the Italian Wars and the role of French naval power in European politics during the 16th century remain topics of interest among historians and military strategists.
